title: solanum nigrum f. paludosum
intro: Solanum nigrum f. paludosum, commonly known as swampy nightshade, is a plant species within the Solanum genus. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Solanum nigrum f. paludosum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as solanine, solanidine, and glycoalkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Solanum nigrum f. paludosum also include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic and health-promoting effects.
